data.name: SourceBiome
data.doc: Immutable source-compatible Map1 geometry/provenance. Source PNG paths are provenance, not runtime art references (child40).

data.name: SourceBiomeCatalog
data.doc: All fifteen ordinary source nodes and the genuine goal, ORIGINAL gradient0 realization. Goal randomness and uninitialized terrain are named deterministic port adaptations; other profiles and runtime handoff remain separate.

data.name: SourceBiomeTailProfiles
data.doc: Offline source-compiled minus/plus-one gradient tail heights as unsigned binary32 bit integers. Gradient zero retains the original SourceBiome record. Runtime composition validates all maps before route activation.
